decision.explanation: The original sources provide conflicting descriptions of the student body at St. Michael Academy. D1S1 describes it as 'an all-boys Roman Catholic high school,' D3S1 refers to it as 'a co-ed private, catholic, college preparatory school,' and D4S3 calls it 'an all-girls, private, Roman Catholic high school.' These statements refer to the same institution but describe different genders for the student body. Since the question asks for what gender the student body is, and the sources do not clarify whether these are historical changes or naming ambiguities, all three answers are valid based on the direct claims found in the provided documents.
